Group & Klaveness Dry Bulk
Brand Guide

Last updated December 2022

Group Logo

The blue logo is mainly used on white backgrounds. When applied to darker surfaces you should use the white version. If you cannot use the main logo due to lack of spacing, use either the portrait or landscape versions, whichever is most suitable. The space between the logo and other elements must be consistent. The minimum amount of clearance around the logo must be equal to the size of the letter “a” in the logo.

Font

The primary font is Source Sans Pro designed by Paul D. Hunt and can be downloaded for free. When Source Sans Pro is not an option, Arial can be used. Visit this site for conditions of use, and download the Source Sans Pro font package.

Wordmark

Edit Serif Pro is the font used and reserved for our logo only.

Colors

The color palette consists of 12 colours. Orange is the accent color of Torvald Klaveness and should not be used by any other Klaveness company.

Templates

In this section you will various templates, scroll down to find:

  • PowerPoint template

  • Power BI template

  • Memo template

  • Letterheads

  • Email signature

  • Business cards

PowerPoint template

The PowerPoint template is available through the template library in PowerPoint and can also be downloaded here. Note: The template includes an “Assets” section with logos and icons for easy use. If you don’t need them, just delete those slides when you finish your deck.

Power BI template

In order to add the Torvald Klaveness theme to your Power BI dashboard, you must download the file for the theme and apply like described here.

Memo template

Compose a memo with this template. It can also be found in the template library in Word.
Letterheads and envelopes

Letterheads and envelopes should display information such as address and contact information of the relevant business unit or office. Letterheads should display information in the top right corner and envelopes should display information in the top left. This applies to all standard shapes and sizes in both envelopes and letter heads. You may download letterheads here and request envelope design by sending an email to hzk@klaveness.com

Email signature

There are two signature versions available for download, a standard signature and employees are to use when communicating on behalf of another Klaveness company. If you are employeed in Klaveness AS for example, and communicate on behalf of Klaveness Combination Carriers ASA, you must always use the “On behalf of Company” signature in your correspondence.

View guide on how to update your email signature

Business cards

We have business card templates for both employees and external consultants.

Vision and values

At the core of Torvald Klaveness are the values we live by and the vision we pursue. Our vision is to improve the nature of shipping and underpins our continued commitment to changing and improving the industry we are part of.

The vision provides direction and guidance along three dimensions:

  • IMPROVING - We always look for new solutions

  • NATURE - Our ambition is to improve the very nature of the business we are in

  • SHIPPING - Shipping is our market and where we can make a difference

Our values define what we stand for and what you can expect from us.

Images and icons

The style of the photos used by Klaveness should appear natural. Photos should be bright, of high quality and present elements in a delicate and visually interesting style. Color and contrast can also be used as stylistic devices. Avoid filters and additional graphic elements in the images. Use the existing palette as a reference for new images and illustrations.

Company presentation

The new company presentation slide deck provides a brief overview of who we are, what we do, and how we are organized. You can select the slides that best fit your audience. Be sure to check the notes section, as some slides, especially the company history, include talking points for reference.

This will be updated regularly to reflect strategic and organizational changes.
